response.title: which crawl space dehumidifier lasts the longest
response.answer:
If your top priority is longevity rather than price, I would focus on commercial-grade crawl space dehumidifiers from Santa Fe, AprilAire, and Quest.

The biggest difference isn't necessarily how many years the manufacturer claims a unit will last. It's the quality of the compressor, corrosion resistance, availability of replacement parts, and whether the unit can be repaired instead of replaced.

A well-built crawl space dehumidifier can potentially last 10–15 years, but that's a reasonable long-term target, not a guaranteed lifespan. Actual service life depends heavily on humidity, temperature, maintenance, and operating hours.

My top two choices for longevity

Santa Fe Compact70 Dehumidifier

Best warranty protection: five years of full-unit coverage plus a sixth year for components. Compact 12-inch height, suitable for many low crawl spaces. 
Santa-Fe
+1

Shop

AprilAire E080 80pt. 4400 sq. ft. Bucketless Dehumidifier in…

80 pints/day · 5-year warranty

$1,779.99

Strong alternative with higher capacity and good efficiency. Particularly attractive if you have local HVAC contractors familiar with AprilAire.

The important caveat: There is no reliable independent lifespan study proving Santa Fe lasts longer than AprilAire. Santa Fe wins my recommendation primarily because of its warranty protection and serviceability, not demonstrated average years to failure. Owner reports include both long-running units and premature failures. 
The Heat & Air Review
+1

How to maximize lifespan

Encapsulate the crawl space to reduce moisture entering it.

Use gravity drainage when practical, avoiding an additional pump that can fail.

Clean or replace filters regularly.

Keep the intake and exhaust unobstructed.

Set humidity around 50–55% rather than running unnecessarily at very low settings.

One question: Is your crawl space encapsulated (sealed with a vapor barrier), or is it vented to the outdoors?

That makes a significant difference in which dehumidifier I'd recommend for the longest service life.
